text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I heard we're doing a different kind of 
training today— What exactly will we be 
doing?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what it is~? Ehehe, I hope it's 
something fun♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking around the academy, I saw a 
group of about ten Umamusume gathered 
together. Twin Turbo seemed to be among 
them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, looks like a good crowd has 
gathered. Let's get started then—a 
full-power game of tag!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Tag? ...That's, unexpectedly normal?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I wonder about that? Wouldn't it 
be better to judge after seeing your 
opponent? After all, the demon is—this one 
right here!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
――... I came here because I heard there 
was good food to be had, only to find such 
nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —Hyoeeek!!!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'll make you both Salisbury steak 
and a steak bowl once we're done.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, that's the deal! Underestimate 
this as just regular tag, and you're gonna 
regret it~"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with Narita Brian as "it," a 
dead-serious game of tag began—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pyoeh!!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's momentum was incredible, 
catching participants one after another. 
In the midst of that—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Machitan and Ikuno too...!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Kh, Turbo's not gonna lose...!! Not even 
against Brian—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —So that's where you are.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whaaahaaaaaa~~~~~!? St-Stay awaaaayyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo leads the charge. Yet Narita 
Brian's momentum is unstoppable. The gap 
begins to close bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just when it seemed Narita Brian's hand 
had finally caught Twin Turbo—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Toryaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo kicked off the ground with 
immense power. As if fired up by 
adversity, she rapidly pulled further and 
further ahead—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, rain began to fall. Even so, 
Twin Turbo kept running away. Unafraid of 
the rain, unafraid of the shadows closing 
in from behind... single-mindedly forward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Made it just in time before the heavy 
downpour, huh.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*, *wheeze*... 
Dammiiiiiit...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Did everyone get caught? But you were 
amazing, Turbo! Lasting all the way to the 
end!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Because of the rain, the tape was 
starting to peel. If they'd held on just a 
bit longer, it would've been trouble.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
See? For Brian to say that about you means 
you're really something special!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*... Really? Turbo was that 
amazing...!?
choice_data_list: In a way, you were invincible.
In a way, you were invincible.
Let's keep front-running from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*... Really? Turbo was that 
amazing...!?
choice_data_list: In a way, you were invincible.
In a way, you were invincible.
Let's keep front-running from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fearing neither foul weather nor fierce 
rivals, being able to front-run with 
everything she had was a kind of talent. I 
told her that it was something no one else 
could do.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. That kind of mental fortitude 
isn't something just anyone can possess.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Really? Is Turbo invincible!? Ehe... 
ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, make sure you eat properly and 
rest today. So you can stay invincible 
from here on out too!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while praising Twin Turbo for 
her hard work, everyone enjoyed Hishi 
Amazon's home-cooked meal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone respected her determination to 
keep front-running at full throttle. I 
told her that if she keeps it up, she'll 
gain even more support.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If I keep running away, will people cheer 
for me even more...? Is that true...!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I get that! Seeing someone try so 
desperately hard just makes you want to 
cheer them on, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Turbo's gonna run away real far!! 
Okay, here I goooooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hurriedly stopping Twin Turbo as she tried 
to dash off again, I suggested that she 
get some good rest since she had worked so 
hard today.
